phase: P9 compensation idempotency after checkpoint recovery

assertions: the second apply step is rejected and earlier work enters reverse compensation
the compensation effect is applied before the injected checkpoint failure
the durable checkpoint remains at the compensation cursor after the failure
recovery observes the same compensation idempotency key
the saga reaches ABORTED without repeating the compensation effect

limitations: The recovery behavior is tested against an idempotent fake provider. No production settlement adapter or real currency/inventory operation is enabled.
